summary: The PR adds real new material (Tannakian transfer of the commuting-product Jordan decomposition), but leaves three located duplicates in place: two call sites that still inline lemmas this PR just factored out, and a point-level product proof that re-derives the general-linear theorem the same PR adds. The new End-level centralizer lemmas also duplicate the existing intertwining lemmas.
